name: Aviary Buy Wall AMM
description: A port of IMD's Pool4 design. Each market pairs a token with wrapped SOL on a constant-product curve that owns all its liquidity: seeded once, with no LP shares and no way to take liquidity out. An inventory cap trims the curve when sells leave it holding too many tokens; trimmed tokens are burned except for the market's reward share, and trimmed SOL becomes a buy wall below the price. Every swap pays the market's fee in SOL, split between IMD and Adam, the suite and the market. Nobody controls a market after its seed. A launchpad graduating a token can create and seed a market in one call through pipeline_seed_liquidity. Anyone may run the keeper jobs that place the wall, burn the retired tokens but the reward share, pay the rewards recipient and sweep each fee share to its wallet, and each recipient may hand its own role to another wallet.

init.description: Creates a market for a token against wrapped SOL. Seed it with the seed action in the same transaction; its parameters never change after creation.

args.name: wall_split_bps
args.label: Share of the market's fee for the buy wall (basis points)

args.name: fee_recipient
args.label: Fee recipient
args.description: Receives the market's part of the fee that does not go to the buy wall. Leave unset only when the wall takes all of it.

args.name: reward_share_bps
args.label: Reward share of trimmed tokens (basis points)

args.name: rewards_recipient
args.label: Rewards recipient
args.description: Receives the reward share of trimmed tokens. Unset exactly when the reward share is 0.

args.name: cap_floor_bps
args.label: Cap floor (basis points of the seeded tokens)

args.name: cap_decay_bps
args.label: Cap decay a day (basis points of the seeded tokens)
args.description: How far buys may lower the inventory cap each day. 0 switches the ratchet off.

args.name: seeder
args.label: Seeder
args.description: The only wallet that may seed the market.

seed_liquidity.description: For a launchpad graduating a token: its program calls pipeline_seed_liquidity, which creates a market for the token against wrapped SOL, takes the seed from the launchpad's escrows and opens it, all in one call. SeedRequest.amounts is exactly two amounts, the tokens then the wrapped SOL to take, under the same rules as the seed action: the token's mint and freeze authorities removed, at least the program's MIN_SEED_LAMPORTS, and an opening price inside the bounds. SeedRequest.data is these arguments, Borsh-encoded in order, exactly as init's: the same creation parameters under the same rules, except the seeder, which is the calling program's PDA that signs and owns both escrows. Accounts: Pipeline's fixed seed accounts (the seeder, the market state below, the payer, the system program and an LP recipient, which is ignored since a buy wall market issues no LP shares), then mint, escrow and token program for the token and then for wrapped SOL, then the accounts below, then the token's transfer-hook accounts. Returns SeedResult with lp_amount 0. Follow it in the same transaction with the router's register_existing_market (no info accounts after the market state) and init_fee_account for each mint. The market state is keyed by the seeder and the token, so a seeder seeds each token once and another seeder of the same token gets another market. The seed stays in the market for good: there is no withdrawal.

args.name: seeder

args.description: Ignored: the calling program's PDA that signs the seed is the market's seeder. Any key will do, the default (all-zero) key included.

actions.name: seed
actions.label: Seed the market
actions.description: Seeds and opens the market, once, signed by its seeder, from the seeder's own token and wrapped SOL accounts. The token's mint and freeze authorities must be removed first. The seed stays in the market for good: there is no withdrawal. A token with a transfer hook needs the hook's accounts after these, which this form cannot add.

actions.name: place_wall
actions.label: Place the buy wall
actions.description: A keeper job anyone may run, in a later slot than the market's last swap: in a slot a swap or the seed already ran in it is refused with SwapThisSlot. Closes the buy wall at the current price and places it again with all the market's idle SOL, below the price at the lower of the price and the wall's floor, which changes only at a slot's first update and rises only slowly after a pump, so a pumped price earns nothing and a dip inside one slot never drags the wall down. Refused until the market's idle SOL, or the SOL the placed wall has spent buying tokens, reaches the program's WALL_THRESHOLD. Tips the caller in wrapped SOL to their own wrapped SOL account, which must exist: at most the program's KEEPER_TIP_CAP and never more than the market's fee on that SOL. It never moves the price.

actions.name: settle
actions.label: Settle retired tokens
actions.description: A keeper job anyone may run. Splits the market's retired tokens: the market's reward share of them is kept for the rewards recipient and the rest is burned, lowering the token's supply. Refused when nothing is retired. No tip, and no signature but the transaction fee payer's. It never moves the price.

actions.name: pay_rewards
actions.label: Pay the rewards
actions.description: A keeper job anyone may run. Pays everything the market owes its rewards recipient, in the token, to the recipient's associated token account, which the caller pays to create if it is missing. Enter the market's current rewards recipient; any other wallet is refused. Refused when nothing is owed. No tip. A token with a transfer hook needs the hook's accounts after these, which this form cannot add.

actions.name: sweep_fees
actions.label: Sweep a fee share
actions.description: A keeper job anyone may run. Pays one share of the market's fees, all of it, in wrapped SOL to the wallet's associated wrapped SOL account, which the caller pays to create if it is missing: slot 0 is the market's fee recipient, slot 1 the designer share for IMD and Adam (refused until the program's DESIGNER_RECIPIENT is set, the SOL waiting in the market), slot 2 the suite share for the program's SUITE_TREASURY. Enter that slot's wallet; any other is refused. Refused when nothing is owed. No tip. The recipient unwraps by closing the account.

args.name: slot
args.label: Fee slot (0 fee recipient, 1 designer, 2 suite)

actions.name: set_fee_recipient
actions.label: Hand over the fee recipient role
actions.description: Signed by the market's current fee recipient only: hands the role, and the fees it is owed, to another wallet, which must not be the default key. A market created with no fee recipient never gets one.

actions.name: set_rewards_recipient
actions.label: Hand over the rewards recipient role
actions.description: Signed by the market's current rewards recipient only: hands the role, and the rewards it is owed, to another wallet, which must not be the default key. A market created with no rewards recipient never gets one.
